text:
nora_support: Customer ACME reporting intermittent 502s to /v1/embeddings in eu1 this morning, spike ~2024-11-02T09:02–09:12Z. sample req id: req=acme-43f2 trace=trace-9a8c. payloads are chunked with ~10KB metadata + 64KB embed body. curl sample attached:
```
curl -v 'https://api.eu1.redwood.com/v1/embeddings' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"...","model":"x-embed-1"}'
```

jordan_sre: thx nora. any traces / envoy logs? which edge node?

nora_support: pasted deploy-bot trace: deploy-bot: TRACE trace-9a8c edge-node=eu1-front-12 upstream=ingress-nginx-2 status=502 "upstream response deadline exceeded". no upstream 5xx in app logs, just 502 at edge.

alex_ryan: sounds like keepalive / connection-pool exhaustion. were these long-lived streaming conns? embeddings are chunked => long streams.

sophia_prod: customer confirms high concurrency from one tenant (~60 concurrent streams). our metric edge.h2.active_streams spiked to 950 at 09:04 UTC.

jordan_sre: can we reproduce internally? nora, ask for minimal repro (concurrency + same chunk sizes).

nora_support: got a repro loop from them. running a 60-parallel curl loop with Transfer-Encoding: chunked reproduces 502s in ~2m.

kevin_infra: envoy metrics show conn_pool_exhausted=true on eu1-front-12, upstream_cx_overflow rising. snippet from node metrics: "pool_capacity=0 conn_pool_exhausted=true upstream_retries=0".

alex_ryan: short-term mitigations: 1) throttle tenant concurrency 2) increase per-worker h2 conn pool / keepalive settings on eu1-front 3) roll back yesterday's nginx pool reduction if that correlates. long-term: add server-side prefix/KV caching for common embed inputs and enforce metadata size limits.

sophia_prod: note: we did push an nginx tuning change in eu1 yesterday that reduced max idle conns per worker. that could be the trigger.

jordan_sre: action items: (A) nora confirm customer ok with temporary throttling (B) kevin open infra ticket to revert nginx pool change on eu1-front-12 (track infra-4567) (C) alex propose a runtime fallback to dedicated capacity on pool saturation.

nora_support: customer agreed to a soft throttle (reduce concurrency to 8 streams). i will apply and monitor.

deploy-bot: infra ticket infra-4567 created by kevin_infra for nginx connpool rollback.

sophia_prod: draft response to customer: "We're temporarily throttling concurrent embed streams from your tenant and rolling back a recent edge config change in eu1 to prevent further 502s. Expect recovery within ~10 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and permanent remediation." :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: also capture pcap / tcpdump on one front node while repro'ing, so we can verify FIN/GOAWAY patterns. alex, kevin, coordinate.

kevin_infra: started tcpdump on eu1-front-12, saving to /var/tmp/repro-trace-9a8c.pcap.

nora_support: i'll confirm recovery with customer once metrics calm. updating support ticket.

end
